verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents metadata filter expressions on queries with operators such as eq, in, gt and and, which covers range comparisons, array/set membership and basic boolean conjunction. Geo filtering and nested boolean logic (or/not, nesting depth) are not evidenced. missing for 10: geo filtering, documented nested boolean logic (or/not combinations), full operator reference, independent hands-on corroboration of complex filters

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries

citations.quote: Narrow Pinecone search results by adding metadata filter expressions to your query, using operators like eq, in, gt, and gt, and for precise retrieval.
you can then include a metadata filter to limit the search to records matching the filter expression
there is more than meets the eye with the combined keyword+vector search and handling of filtering
